notes.title: LIMORIA UPDATE V1.1 🎮🔧
notes.notes:
Hello dear players,

We’ve released a small but important update to enhance your gaming experience! Here’s what’s new in this patch:

Interact Dot Improvement
The interaction point has been fine-tuned. Picking up objects is now smoother and more responsive.

Bug Fixes
Several pesky bugs have been squashed to ensure a more seamless gameplay experience.

Optimization Enhancements
We’ve addressed some performance issues. Expect a more stable and faster game.

Key Collision Adjustment
Interactions with keys have been improved. You can now use them with greater ease.

Your feedback means the world to us. Stay tuned for more updates and improvements!

Happy gaming!
